item.title: Rallying Cry – June 13, 2026
item.description: Resident doctors end their strike with a new government deal, Qatar scores a dramatic late goal to make World Cup history, thousands rally against racism in Belfast, and Emma Raducanu calls herself a "new, better" player after reaching her biggest final in years.
